criteria.criterion: A recorded defect is escaped when its created time is after the committer time of its brief's release commit (M-5), whatever its found-by; a record created in the same second is not escaped. Otherwise it counts by found-by as today: gate and review in-loop, operator operator, user escaped. A brief that is not merged has no release, so its records count by found-by.
criteria.evidence: internal/metrics/defects.go:156 Reclassify uses !at.After(released) (same second stays), zero released returns early; released is the %ct committer time of runs.Release (metrics.go:200-212)

criteria.criterion: The rule applies to every record, old and new, everywhere the counts are computed (vloop metrics' summary and JSON, the all-briefs table, close's summary and snapshot); no record is edited or migrated.
criteria.evidence: Reclassify is applied once in metrics.Build (metrics.go:245), which cli/metrics.go, cli/close.go and driver/snapshot.go all call; records are only read

criteria.criterion: Removal efficiency stays (in-loop + operator) / all; `defect list --matrix` is unchanged (origin by catcher).
criteria.evidence: RemovalEfficiency untouched in defects.go; Reclassify works on DefectCounts only, the Matrix is not modified

criteria.criterion: The release commit's time is read through the one git runner (T2).
